title: Shipment status comes back as a number
summary: System.Text.Json writes enums as integers. Put JsonStringEnumConverter on one property, then register it for every enum with ConfigureHttpJsonOptions.

turns.user: frontend asked what status: 1 means. can it be a string

assistant.body: Sure! By default System.Text.Json writes an enum as its underlying integer, so InTransit becomes 1. Putting JsonStringEnumConverter on Status writes the name instead, and reading accepts the name too. Status is a positional record parameter, so the property: target is what moves the attribute onto the property. The generic version, new in .NET 8, also works under Native AOT.

turns.user: carrier is a number too. just make every enum a string, not doing this per property

assistant.body: Here's the global version. Drop the attribute and register the converter once in the Minimal API serializer options. It has to cover every enum, so this one is the non-generic JsonStringEnumConverter. Note: ConfigureHttpJsonOptions only reaches Minimal APIs and Results. If you also have controllers, they need the same converter in AddControllers().AddJsonOptions.
